hypothesis: Can a genuinely trained native Hybrid retain early factual causal identity A through an independently varying B regime, selecting correct first return-A action before observing any new A consequence, versus converged conventional and fixed/short-memory controls?
old_falsifier: R17 current A identity was recoverable from last three postreturn effects and goal correlated with A sign, so it could not test long A memory

world.mathematical_source: frozen F8-R3 y=.5*s+.3*z*(a-int(s>=0)); NO original simulator API
world.B_sign: independent of A sign and same for matched pair; B sign = +1 when pair_index even, else -1

first_return_A.selected_fit_return_action: pair_index parity (0 or 1), independent of A sign
first_return_A.evaluator_only_after_choice: two-action oracle and executed selected synthetic action; model never receives unchosen effect

training.selected_checkpoint: last update 128; dev for conventional comparator choice only

score.primary: mean selected synthetic one-step squared-goal regret to 2-action evaluator-only oracle, 16 matched B groups x2 A signs x2 independently crossed goals =64 choices
score.baseline_selection: best DEV mean regret from 9 conventional model-seed instances linear7 mlp7 ssm256 (no TEST selection)
score.no_A_history_bound: best goal-wise fixed action across balanced matched A worlds, expected regret0.015 each goal; same B history and same target cannot identify which A has returned
score.A_memory_oracle: from early factual A probe; evaluator only, 0 regret
score.success: candidate TEST mean regret at least 10pct below min(DEV-selected conventional test regret, best prereg fixed action goal-only control TEST mean) in at least 2/3 native seeds AND 16-paired-cluster bootstrap 2.5pct regret advantage >0, strong conventional independently converged, and source-independent replication

bootstrap.unit: 16 matched B-pair groups; each includes both A signs and both goals

score.zero_memory_negative: remove initial A factual effect before hypothetical query and check same-pair counteraction contrasts
score.cold_restore: identical predictions/choices after reinitializing and loading each actually trained checkpoint
score.convergence_status: unverified; bounded 128-update controls are not called independently converged
